summary: CPU-guarded function-pointer table initializer for the 3DNow/MMX math dispatch table. Probes CPU feature flags via sub_5171D0; when bits 0x20 and 0x80 of the result are set, fills the 57 dword slots of the table at a1 with 3DNow/MMX-optimized math routines (matrix multiply/transpose/inverse, quaternion product/composition/rotation, vector normalize/blend/negate, barycentric/cubic/bezier/quadrilinear interpolation, axis-angle and transform-matrix construction). When bits 0x100 and 0x200 are additionally set, overrides five entries (slots 15, 18, 24, 38, 39) with alternative optimized implementations. Returns the feature flags from sub_5171D0. Invoked by sub_50FEA7 during dispatch-table setup.

local_names.a1: output function-pointer table (57 dword slots, 3DNow/MMX math dispatch)
local_names.result: CPU feature flags returned by sub_5171D0, used both as the guard mask and the return value

unresolved: sub_5171D0 is not decomposed in this packet; the exact meanings of feature bits 0x20, 0x80, 0x100 and 0x200 (which CPU SIMD capabilities each denotes) cannot be determined here.
The owning object of the table at a1 is not evidenced; slot semantics are inferred from routine names only, not from a caller-side dispatch contract.
The inner-guard writes overwrite the base assignments on slots 15, 18, 24, 38 and 39; whether the replacement routines are faster variants or semantically different operations is unknown.
